pairs.note: High-yield spread vs. HY bond ETF — higher spread should precede weaker HYG returns
Investment-grade spread vs. IG bond ETF
Long yield vs. long Treasury ETF — yields up should precede TLT down (inverse by construction)
Short yield vs. T-Bill ETF — expect a weak relationship, BIL barely moves either way
DXY level vs. the Dollar's own ETF — this one SHOULD show a strong positive relationship almost by construction (UUP tracks the dollar), useful as a sanity check on the whole method
Fed balance sheet size vs. the most liquidity-sensitive mapped asset (Nasdaq/Growth)
Bank reserves level vs. Nasdaq/Growth — reserves falling has historically meant tighter liquidity
TGA balance vs. Nasdaq/Growth — TGA rising pulls cash OUT of the banking system
VIX level vs. S&P 500 — VIX is literally derived from S&P options, so some relationship here is close to definitional
Chicago Fed's financial conditions index vs. S&P 500
